description: Navigate your tab to a URL. Returns at the requested milestone (default: DOM ready) — it does not wait for load, which SPAs often never fire.

wait_until.description: How far to wait. commit = navigation committed (fastest, content may not be painted); domcontentloaded = DOM ready (default, safe for SPAs); load = also subresources (can hang forever on pages that never fire load).

name: browse_navigate
title: Navigate tab
